purpose: Fix the defects that the independent #181/#399 reviews confirmed on Profile, plans and providers, sign-in and re-authentication, the bug report and menus, plus the #513 review follow-ups.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-11 the owner instructed in the controlling session: "do all. complete all work. merge to main. clean worktrees. tell me when all issues in PR's are resolved." and earlier delegated product decisions to this session ("Review the product and guidlines. Make own decision"). On 2026-10-11 the owner repeated the instruction to turn the #181/#399 report findings into fixes. This campaign repairs the defects confirmed by the independently verified review reports R6-PROFILE (Dyk #181 comment 6110906108), R7-AUTH (comment 6111045485) and R8-BUGREPORT (comment 6111148491) of campaign dyk-181-399-review, and the non-blocking follow-ups of the independent review of Dyk PR #513 (comment 6111150229). Design choices the reports left open are decided in the controller fix plan posted on Dyk #181 (comment 6111164175) with the reason for each. No owner-reserved item is touched (manual task editing stays as is per the owner). Bounded repairs under Dyk AGENTS.md section 4; visible changes are represented in Storybook and independently reviewed before merge. PRs only, never merge or deploy; no production access. No limits; provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Providers Claude then Codex (owner: "Use codex or claude agent").

constraints: No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions, paid services, or Playwright and other browser-driven tests (Dyk owner rule). Local disposable SQL only through the repository runners (npm run test:sql / npm run journeys with a selected scope) when a task changes a route or persistence; never the production database.

Keep the affected Storybook stories in sync with every renderer change (Storybook is not post-hoc documentation). RU/EN/HE, true Hebrew RTL, 320/390 widths, 44px hit areas, no horizontal overflow, truthful states (T2).
Never read .env contents, credentials, private conversations or real user data; fixtures are synthetic.
A Storybook build or passing tests is not visual acceptance; each PR lists the story ids for independent visual review and states that the visual verdict is pending.

Do not remove worktrees, delete branches or link another checkout's node_modules. Do not add any new blocking gate, lock, required approval or check that depends on owner-provisioned keys, credentials or setup (Dyk AGENTS.md section 4).
Never weaken an existing test, guard or assertion; never add a capability outside the accepted feature map unless the task names the owner decision that adds it.

Open PR #500 (another session) rewrites short copy in about 20 files, including task-board-ui.js and screen-copy.js. Change copy in those files only where an item needs it, keep each edit minimal, and say in the PR which #500 files you touched.
Do not change any task editing behavior (date, title, action, summary, Done/Undo, person correction): the owner decided to keep it as is.
Campaigns dyk-review-fixes (Summary, Sources, chat reader, tooling) and dyk-review-fixes-setup (Setup) are changing those surfaces at the same time; do not edit them here.

Authentication, session, CSRF validation and redirect safety must not change: sign-in fixes are limited to UI, copy and link targets; every return or language parameter goes through the existing safe-return validation, and the existing auth security tests keep passing unchanged.
